<thought>To determine the number of methyl groups, I will obtain the 13C NMR spectrum of the sample (which requires no arguments) and count the distinct carbon signals in the typical methyl region (≈10–30 ppm). Each such signal corresponds to a unique methyl carbon, giving the number of methyl groups.</thought>
